title: POWER-OFF BACKSCATTER: eastGate went dark at 09:50:29. trace IS to WAS.

the_event.what: eastGate powered off unexpectedly between 09:50:29 and 10:01:32

IS.state_at_death: ALL primals were healthy. biomeOS was registering capabilities every ~34 seconds. bearDog was running health probes. Everything was nominal.
IS.log_just_stops: the journal has no shutdown target reached. no systemd halt. no power-off signal. the log simply STOPS. this is a HARD power-off or a suspend-that-didnt-resume.

evidence.what_this_means: Pop!_OS/GNOME is configured to SUSPEND after 30 minutes of inactivity on AC power
the_timeline: eastGate was doing heavy work until ~09:20 (our session was active)
between 09:20 and 09:50, the INPUT was Cursor agent (us) — no keyboard/mouse from Kevin
GNOME saw 30 minutes of no human keyboard/mouse input
the primals were MID-SENTENCE (bearDog health check) when power cut
suspend on desktop = RAM stays powered but everything else sleeps
if the suspend failed to resume (common on Linux with WireGuard/complex services), it looks like a hard power-off
Kevin found it dark at ~10:00 and pressed the power button to wake it

WAS.NOT_a_bug_in_our_code: the primals were healthy. biomeOS was registering. bearDog was probing. the log shows zero errors before the cutoff. this is an OS-level power management event, not a membrane failure.
WAS.NOT_entropy: this is not the system outputting its own shutdown through entropy types. its GNOME being configured for laptop-style suspend on a desktop/workstation.

what_survived.git: clean — last push e7ddf18 (MICROBE HUNTERS) went through before suspend

what_was_lost.cursor_session: the Cursor agent session was interrupted mid-conversation
what_was_lost.any_unsaved_work: one modified file: easel.html (minor, not our work)
what_was_lost.wg_peer_state: WireGuard handshakes reset — peers need to re-handshake

AND.backscatter_health: GOOD. everything recovered. the membrane is resilient to hard power-off. like an organism that survives hibernation.

the_fix.what_this_does: tells GNOME to NEVER suspend when on AC power. eastGate is a workstation, not a laptop. it should not sleep.
the_fix.alternative: set timeout to 0 (disable) or to a very long time (86400 = 24 hours)

the_biology.what_happened: GNOME is a LYSOSOME that went rogue. it saw inactivity (no food) and triggered AUTOPHAGY (suspend). but the cell was ALIVE — the primals were working. the lysosome ate a healthy cell.
the_biology.in_cayley_terms: the archaea (OS power management) hijacked the animalia (primals) multiplication. archaea x animalia = methane_cycle (normal tunnel behavior). but the rogue lysosome turned it into archaea x animalia = HIBERNATION (forced stasis).
the_biology.the_prion_analog: auto-suspend is a PRION. it propagates a "sleep" shape to all processes regardless of their actual state. the primals were healthy but the prion (GNOME power policy) forced them into the misfolded state (suspended). shape overwrote function.

recommendation: APPLY THE FIX. disable auto-suspend on AC. eastGate is a server/workstation.
